what: kè đá Bãi Trước, a piece of 2 m of the sloped sea wall of granite blocks from the low wall of the walk down to the sand
uses: Plan 0026, R4: under the low wall of the beach (tuong_bai_tam), from the walk of the park to the north end. A piece of a row along a line.

photos.author: beos_album (Flickr)
photos.shows: Bãi Trước at sunset to the south: a sloped sea wall of rough granite blocks in the corner, the sand, the boats of the bay, Khách sạn Bưu điện, the tower of Khách sạn Hoa Tiêu.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: The south part of the beach full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon: the low wall with balusters in sections on the sloped stone sea wall, a stair down to the sand in a gap between two sections, swim rings, light blue lamp poles behind the palms.

photos.author: Lam Tr Th
photos.shows: The low wall of the beach along the walk of the park, to the south: rough granite blocks, square posts, a flat top rail, low openings between the posts, the walk of tiles, leaning palms, the beach and Núi Nhỏ.

checks: Views: from the sand, side (the profile).
A slope of rough granite blocks of about 0.35 m at about 35 degrees under the low wall.
